Messages.Author: Fra_tes
Messages.Body:
Hi Everybody,
Can Blood of Acid be prevented by strike prevention cards like Skin of Steel or prevention cards like Skin of Rock or Rego Motus?

Thanks!

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
The damage from Blood of Acid is not "from a strike" so Skin of Steel or Rego Motum cannot be played.
Skin of Rock is fine.
